entities.name: Erwin Rommel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: German field marshal (1891–1944) known as the "Desert Fox" for his command of the Afrika Korps in North Africa during World War II. His audacious tank tactics and ability to improvise made him one of the most respected commanders of the war. Implicated in the July 20 plot against Hitler, he was forced to take cyanide in 1944.
